title: Mobility Equipment Safety Bulletin — Removing Portable Oxygen Mounts for Drive-Unit Work
content:
# Portable Oxygen Mount Removal on Drive-Unit Work — Mobility Equipment

**Bulletin.** A mount-removal allowance is added to the labor units claimed from the manufacturer for a warranty drive motor or gearbox replacement on a Mobility Equipment chair when the patient's Home Oxygen Therapy record is rental active or payment cap reached: 1 unit when its portable equipment is a portable oxygen concentrator (E1392), 2 units when it is a cylinder, home-fill or liquid portable (E0431, K0738 or E0434), and nothing when there is no such oxygen record or no portable equipment.

## What is read

The status of the patient's Home Oxygen Therapy record and the portable equipment code of its oxygen class. A Home Oxygen Therapy record in a status other than rental active or payment cap reached counts as no such record.

| Portable equipment of the oxygen class (record rental active or payment cap reached) | Mount-removal allowance |
|---|---|
| portable oxygen concentrator (E1392) | 1 unit |
| portable cylinders (E0431) | 2 units |
| home-fill system (K0738) | 2 units |
| liquid oxygen portable (E0434) | 2 units |
| no portable equipment | none |

With no Home Oxygen Therapy record in either status, the allowance is none.

## Hypothetical case

A patient whose Home Oxygen Therapy rental with portable cylinders is rental active has a drive motor replaced under warranty: 2 units.
